biotools.summary: This tool standardizes slice thickness in CT scans by resampling them to a common slice spacing. It is intended as a preprocessing step to harmonize CT data, improving consistency across scans acquired with varying slice thicknesses.

function.note:
The application accepts 4 parameters:
The input path to a DICOM directory
The output directory where harmonized DICOM will be saved.
The model to use (options: lung)
The type of input (options: series -folder containing .dcm files of a DICOM image- or study -folder containing series)

biotools.name: CT Slice thickness harmonization
